description: build_headers and with_cache are pure header utilities called from fetcher.cr, software/*.cr, youtube.cr, and tests. They have no dependency on CrestHttpClient state. They are already documented in src/fetcher/header_builder.cr. Keep thin class-method shims on CrestHttpClient that delegate to HeaderBuilder so external callers (.new-style API) continue to work.
title: Move build_headers / with_cache to HeaderBuilder
